label: The chopped-off word piece 'EA'/'ea' (also 'EO', 'MEA') when a longer acronym, name or code string splits so that piece stands alone: EEA, OEA, UEA, EMEA, EEOC, Medea, Sacagawea, apnoea, base64 '...AQEA...'. Weaker second trigger: a lone 'a' or 'o' piece right after an 'e' piece (Boadicea, NCEA, Tadeo). Quiet for whole words holding 'ea' (idea, area, beach; tea/sea only weak), whole-token acronyms and names (CEO, Korea, Samoa), acronyms where 'EA' is fused into a bigger piece (IAEA), and -ae endings (Mycenae).

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit
